---
title: "About"
---

I am Faran Abbas, a graduate student in World Economy at Shandong University. You can view my work on [GitHub](https://github.com/faranabbas-repo) or contact me at faranabbas@hotmail.com.

This project investigates how fiscal policy and trade openness affect GDP using cross-country data from 2000–2024. You can view the repository [here](https://github.com/faranabbas-repo/fiscal-trade-gdp.git).

This project was created as a part of [Kane’s Data Science Bootcamp](https://bootcamp.davidkane.info/).
